desks.headline: Make a useful introduction.
desks.summary: If two women might help each other, ask each privately whether she would welcome an introduction. Only connect them if both agree, and explain the specific reason. An introduction should arrive with context, not as a surprise assignment. Next time you speak with either woman, ask whether the connection was useful. If it missed the mark, find out what you misunderstood before making another suggestion.
